name: Can I repair rot damage myself or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair rot damage myself or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, non-structural areas of rot damage that are easily accessible and don't involve load-bearing elements, a homeowner with DIY experience might be able to handle the repair. However, for larger areas, structural components, or if the source of moisture isn't clear, hiring a professional general contractor is highly recommended. Professionals have the expertise to properly diagnose the cause, effectively remove all compromised material, correctly reinforce structures, and prevent recurrence, ensuring a durable and safe repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for minor, non-structural rot; hire a professional for larger, structural damage or if the moisture source is unclear.
